title: Tom's Sports
text:
Tom likes football. He plays football on Saturday with his friends. They play in the park.

Tom also likes swimming. He swims in the pool on Monday. After swimming, he feels happy and tired.

questions.text: What sport does Tom play on Saturday?
How does Tom probably feel after swimming?
Why does Tom probably enjoy sports?
options: He likes to be active and spend time with friends
He does not like other people
He has no free time at all
He is afraid of the park

vocabulary.definition: people you like and spend time with
a public place with grass and trees where people can relax
a place with water where people swim
wanting to rest because you have used a lot of energy

paragraph_translations: A Tom le gusta el fútbol. Juega al fútbol el sábado con sus amigos. Ellos juegan en el parque.
A Tom también le gusta nadar. Nada en la piscina el lunes. Después de nadar, se siente feliz y cansado.
